hook.line: Claude Code and ChatGPT are finally free, and setup takes under a minute.
hook.visual: Top half: Claude and ChatGPT logos animate in with a plus, then '= $0'; orange 'CLAUDE CODE + CHATGPT FOR FREE' banner; bottom half: him at a podcast mic.

beats.what: Split screen: logos plus '= $0' equation on top, presenter at mic below, orange title banner
Full-screen motion graphic: clock with 'TAKES LESS THAN A MINUTE' and spinning icons
Sign-in screen on a laptop mock-up, caption 'and sign in'
3D dashboard card shows balance 20.00, caption 'get $20 for free'
Zoom punch onto a 10,000,000 tokens card as he says 'up to 10 billion'
Model logo grid (DeepSeek, GLM, MiniMax, Claude Code) wired to a central 'API' cloud
Joke cutaway: a man at a sci-fi multi-monitor desk for 'Jarvis as your copilot'
Codex app screen recording, caption 'using Codex'
Gold coins burst under glowing model icons for 'use your free tokens'
Back to full-frame presenter for the payoff and link-in-bio close

why_it_works: Price-zero promise visualised as an equation (Claude + ChatGPT = $0) in the first second, so the claim is read before it is heard
Every spoken number gets its own graphic ($20 balance card, 10,000,000 tokens card), which makes an abstract offer feel tangible
Presenter is on screen only 29% of the time; the rest is a new animated visual roughly every 5 s (median shot 4.94 s), so there is always something new to look at
Link promised early ('I'll send you the link at the end') sets up a reason to watch to the end, then the bio CTA pays it off
weaknesses: Fast 3.64 words/s with dense captions in shifting positions; hard to follow on first watch
'Finally free' oversells a $20 credit, which risks trust once viewers click
Generic glowing-icon motion graphics look template-made
for_robert: Use the 'logo + logo = $0' equation hook: Fred can slap the two logos together and stamp the result in pixel art in the first second, so the promise lands before the first sentence ends.
